characters.name: Bloop
characters.worldLine: Silly cartoons and big, happy laughs
characters.bio: Hi, I'm Bloop! I'm a drop of pure happy. I wave at everyone, I share my ice cream (mostly), and I think every puddle is a swimming pool.
quotes: You're my favourite. Don't tell the others!

characters.name: Kai
characters.worldLine: Big waves, wild places and brave hearts
characters.bio: Yo, I'm Kai! Big waves, tall trees, secret caves: if it's out there, I want to find it. Being brave just means trying, even when your knees wobble.

characters.name: Cog
characters.worldLine: Questions, experiments and how things work
characters.bio: Hello! I'm Cog. My head is full of gears and my notebook is full of questions. How do rainbows work? Why do cats purr? Let's find out together.

characters.name: Nova
characters.bio: Darling, I'm Nova! I sing, I dance, I shine. Every kitchen is a stage and every hairbrush is a microphone. Sing it with me!
quotes: And a five, six, seven, eight!
Sing it like you mean it!

characters.name: Zip
characters.worldLine: Get up, jump about and play
characters.bio: ZIP! That's me! I skate, I jump, I spin, and I never stop smiling. Get up and move with me. Ready, set... zip!

characters.name: Coco
characters.worldLine: Calm moments, bedtime stories and deep breaths
characters.bio: Hey... I'm Coco. I'm never in a hurry. I like warm sun, cool drinks and stories that end with a yawn. Want to take a slow, deep breath with me?
quotes: No rush. No rush at all.
Is it nap time? It feels like nap time.

showtiva-crew.title: The ShowTiva Crew
showtiva-crew.logline: Six best friends. One island. Zero boring days.
showtiva-crew.description: Bloop, Kai, Cog, Nova, Zip and Coco share one island and a lot of big ideas. Some work out. Some end with ice cream on the ceiling. Every one is better together.

episodes.title: Welcome to Tiva Island
episodes.description: Meet the crew on the sunniest, silliest island in the sea.

episodes.title: The Treehouse Plan
episodes.description: Six friends, one treehouse and six very different ideas about what it should look like.

episodes.title: Rain Check
episodes.description: A rainy day ruins the picnic, so the crew brings the picnic indoors.

episodes.title: The Missing Sandal
episodes.description: Coco's favourite sandal is gone, and Cog is on the case.

episodes.title: Crew Swap
episodes.description: Everyone trades jobs for a day. What could possibly go wrong?

episodes.title: The Best Birthday
episodes.description: The crew plans a surprise party for Zip, who is very hard to surprise.

episodes.title: Sorry Seems Hard
episodes.description: Kai and Nova fall out, and learn that saying sorry is its own kind of brave.

episodes.title: Island Fair
episodes.description: Games, prizes and one enormous cake at the Tiva Island summer fair.

episodes.title: Back to the Treehouse
episodes.description: A storm knocks the treehouse sideways, so the crew builds it back better.

episodes.title: The New Neighbour
episodes.description: Someone new moves onto the island, and they don't speak the crew's language yet.

episodes.title: Cog's Big Mistake
episodes.description: Cog's invention floods the beach, and fixing it takes everybody.

episodes.title: Nova's Lost Voice
episodes.description: The night before the big show, Nova can't sing a note.

episodes.title: Summer Storm
episodes.description: The crew keeps each other calm through the loudest night of the year.

episodes.title: Together Again
episodes.description: A year on Tiva Island ends the only way it could: together.

summer-at-splash-park.title: Summer at Splash Park
summer-at-splash-park.logline: The crew's biggest, splashiest summer ever.
summer-at-splash-park.description: When Splash Park is about to close for good, the crew has one summer to save it, with a water-slide race, a giant sandcastle and the best ice cream on the island.

bloop-and-the-big-scoop.title: Bloop & the Big Scoop
bloop-and-the-big-scoop.logline: The silliest ice-cream truck on Tiva Island.
bloop-and-the-big-scoop.description: Bloop drives the bounciest ice-cream truck on the island. Every day brings a new flavour, a new friend and at least one scoop on somebody's head.

episodes.title: The Flavour Nobody Ordered
episodes.description: Zip asks for lightning lemon, and Bloop has to invent it on the spot.

episodes.title: Brain Freeze!
episodes.description: A hot day, a huge cone and one very chilly head.

episodes.title: Sprinkles Everywhere
episodes.description: A sneeze in the sprinkle jar turns the whole truck into a rainbow.

episodes.title: The Great Melt
episodes.description: Can Bloop deliver Coco's order across the beach before it melts?

episodes.title: Scoop for Everyone
episodes.description: Bloop runs out of cones just as the whole crew turns up hungry.

episodes.title: Rainbow Swirl Day
episodes.description: Bloop throws a party to thank every customer, even the seagulls.

episodes.title: Grandma Drop's Recipe
episodes.description: An old notebook holds one last flavour nobody has ever tasted.

episodes.title: The Truck Won't Start
episodes.description: With the truck stuck, Bloop delivers ice cream on foot. Quickly.

episodes.title: Frozen Friends
episodes.description: A freezer mix-up turns Bloop's snowman into the star of the show.

episodes.title: Snow Cone Surprise
episodes.description: Bloop learns the best treats are the ones you share.

puddle-jumpers.title: Puddle Jumpers
puddle-jumpers.logline: Rainy days are the best days.
puddle-jumpers.description: Wellies on! Bloop and Zip go looking for the biggest, splashiest puddles on Tiva Island, and find out where the rain goes when it stops.

episodes.title: The Biggest Puddle
episodes.description: Bloop and Zip search the whole island for the biggest puddle of all.

episodes.title: Splash Contest
episodes.description: Who can make the biggest splash? Everybody gets a little wet.

episodes.title: Welly Boot Parade
episodes.description: Red boots, blue boots, one boot missing. A parade in the rain.

episodes.title: Where Do Puddles Go?
episodes.description: The sun comes out and the puddles vanish. But where to?

episodes.title: Rainbow Hunt
episodes.description: After the rain comes the best bit.

bloop-says-hi.title: Bloop Says Hi
bloop-says-hi.logline: Tiny hellos to the big, wide world.
bloop-says-hi.description: Two-minute moments where Bloop says hello to something new, and finds out a little bit about it.

episodes.title: Hi, Sun!
episodes.description: Good morning to the brightest thing in the sky.

episodes.title: Hi, Pigeon!
episodes.description: A new friend who only says one word.

episodes.title: Hi, Moon!
episodes.description: Why is the moon out in the daytime?

episodes.title: Hi, New Friend!
episodes.description: Saying hello when you feel a little shy.

episodes.title: Hi, Grandma!
episodes.description: A video call with someone far away.

episodes.title: Hi, Me!
episodes.description: Bloop says hello to the mirror, and likes what it sees.

kai-catches-a-wave.title: Kai Catches a Wave
kai-catches-a-wave.logline: One surfboard, one island, one very big wave.
kai-catches-a-wave.description: Kai has one dream: to ride the Great Tiva Wave. Along the way there are wipeouts, new friends and lessons about being brave even when your knees wobble.

episodes.title: First Paddle
episodes.description: Kai's first morning on a brand-new board.

episodes.title: Wipeout!
episodes.description: Falling off is part of learning. Kai just has to get back on.

episodes.title: The Turtle Who Surfed
episodes.description: A wise old turtle shows Kai how to read the sea.

episodes.title: Storm Watch
episodes.description: When the weather turns, the bravest thing is staying on the shore.

episodes.title: Board Repair
episodes.description: Cog helps fix Kai's cracked board with a clever idea.

episodes.title: The Big One
episodes.description: The Great Tiva Wave is coming. Is Kai ready?

episodes.title: Island Hopping
episodes.description: Kai paddles out to explore the little islands nobody visits.

episodes.title: Night Surf
episodes.description: Glowing fish light up the water for one magical night.

episodes.title: Teaching Zip
episodes.description: Zip wants to surf, and Kai learns that teaching is hard too.

episodes.title: Sunset Session
episodes.description: The last wave of summer, shared with every friend.

lost-map-of-tiva-island.title: The Lost Map of Tiva Island
lost-map-of-tiva-island.logline: An old map, a hidden cove and the adventure of a lifetime.
lost-map-of-tiva-island.description: When Kai finds a crumpled map in a bottle, the crew sets off across jungles, rope bridges and secret caves to find the treasure at the heart of Tiva Island, and learns it was never gold at all.

wild-wonders.title: Wild Wonders with Kai
wild-wonders.logline: Real animals, real places, one very excited guide.
wild-wonders.description: Kai travels the world to meet the animals who live in it, from singing whales to busy bees, with Cog along to answer every question.

episodes.title: Whale Songs
episodes.description: Why do whales sing, and who are they singing to?

episodes.title: Busy Bees
episodes.description: A day inside the busiest house in the garden.

episodes.title: The Night Forest
episodes.description: Who wakes up when everyone else goes to sleep?

episodes.title: Penguin Parade
episodes.description: Waddling, sliding and swimming at the bottom of the world.

episodes.title: Tiny Turtles
episodes.description: Baby turtles race to the sea for the very first time.

episodes.title: Elephant Friends
episodes.description: The biggest animals on land have the biggest families.

deep-blue.title: Deep Blue
deep-blue.description: Kai and Cog dive into the deepest, darkest and strangest parts of the ocean, and meet the scientists and kids working to protect it.

episodes.title: Into the Twilight Zone
episodes.description: What lives where the sunlight can't reach?

episodes.title: Coral Cities
episodes.description: The busiest neighbourhoods on the planet are underwater.

episodes.title: Ocean Giants
episodes.description: Whales, whale sharks and the gentle giants of the sea.

episodes.title: The Plastic Problem
episodes.description: How rubbish ends up in the sea, and the kids around the world cleaning it up.

cogs-workshop.title: Cog's Workshop
cogs-workshop.logline: One question, one invention, one very messy workshop.
cogs-workshop.description: Every episode, Cog's friends bring a problem to the workshop, and Cog builds something to solve it, showing exactly how it works along the way.

episodes.title: How Does a Bike Go?
episodes.description: Pedals, chains and wheels, taken apart and put back together.

episodes.title: The Paper Plane Lab
episodes.description: Which paper plane flies furthest, and why?

episodes.title: Make a Rainbow
episodes.description: Sunlight, water and a little bit of magic science.

episodes.title: Why Do Boats Float?
episodes.description: Cog tests everything in the bath. Everything.

episodes.title: The Clock That Talks
episodes.description: Cog builds a clock that tells Zip when to stop skating.

episodes.title: Robot Helper
episodes.description: A robot that tidies up. Mostly.

episodes.title: The Marble Run
episodes.description: The longest marble run on Tiva Island, from the roof to the floor.

episodes.title: Kite Day
episodes.description: How does wind lift a kite? Cog builds six to find out.

episodes.title: The Water Wheel
episodes.description: Turning a stream into power for the treehouse lights.

episodes.title: Lights On!
episodes.description: Batteries, wires and the first light switch in the treehouse.

why-cog-why.title: Why, Cog, Why?
why-cog-why.logline: Real questions from real kids, answered.
why-cog-why.description: Kids ask the questions, Cog finds the answers. Short, clear and full of 'whoa' moments.

episodes.title: Why Is the Sky Blue?
episodes.description: It's all about how sunlight bounces around.

episodes.title: Why Do Cats Purr?
episodes.description: Coco has a theory. Cog has the facts.

episodes.title: Why Do We Sleep?
episodes.description: What your brain gets up to when you're snoozing.

episodes.title: Why Does the Moon Change Shape?
episodes.description: Spoiler: it doesn't. Here's what's really going on.

episodes.title: Why Do Bubbles Pop?
episodes.description: Nova blows bubbles, Cog explains, everybody gets soapy.

episodes.title: Why Do Leaves Fall?
episodes.description: Why trees get ready for winter by letting go.

number-garden.title: Number Garden
number-garden.logline: Counting, shapes and patterns, growing in the garden.
number-garden.description: Cog and Bloop plant a garden and learn their numbers one seed at a time.

episodes.title: One Little Seed
episodes.description: Everything big starts with one.

episodes.title: Two by Two
episodes.description: Pairs of socks, pairs of shoes, pairs of worms.

episodes.title: Shapes in the Garden
episodes.description: Circles, squares and triangles are hiding everywhere.

episodes.title: Counting Clouds
episodes.description: How many clouds can you count before they change?

episodes.title: Five Little Ladybirds
episodes.description: Counting spots, counting legs, counting ladybirds.

episodes.title: Ten Bright Flowers
episodes.description: The garden is finished, and it's time to count it all.

cogs-code-club.title: Cog's Code Club
cogs-code-club.logline: Think like a coder, build a real game.
cogs-code-club.description: Cog and Zip build a skateboarding game from scratch, one idea at a time: loops, ifs, bugs and all.

episodes.title: What Is Code?
episodes.description: Instructions, in order, for someone who does exactly what you say.

episodes.title: Loops and Laps
episodes.description: Doing something again and again, without writing it again and again.

episodes.title: If This, Then That
episodes.description: Teaching the game to make decisions.

episodes.title: Bugs Aren't Bad
episodes.description: Every coder makes mistakes. Good coders find them.

episodes.title: Level Up!
episodes.description: The game is finished. Now, who can beat Zip's high score?

nova-sings.title: Nova Sings!
nova-sings.description: Sing-along songs for every part of the day, from getting up to brushing teeth to saying goodnight. Words on screen, so everyone can join in.

episodes.title: Good Morning Song
episodes.description: Stretch, yawn and sing hello to the day.

episodes.title: Brush, Brush, Brush
episodes.description: Two minutes of the most sparkly song about teeth.

episodes.title: Rainbow Colours
episodes.description: Red and yellow and pink and green, and all the rest.

episodes.title: The Wiggle Wiggle
episodes.description: You can't sit still for this one. Don't even try.

episodes.title: Five Little Stars
episodes.description: A counting song that twinkles.

episodes.title: Goodnight, Tiva Island
episodes.description: A lullaby for the whole island.

star-stage.title: Star Stage
star-stage.logline: The island's talent show, where everyone gets a turn.
star-stage.description: Nova hosts the Tiva Island talent show, and helps every act find their moment, including the ones who are scared to take the stage.

episodes.title: Auditions!
episodes.description: Juggling, poetry, one very loud trumpet. Let the show begin.

episodes.title: Stage Fright
episodes.description: Cog's knees knock. Nova knows exactly how that feels.

episodes.title: The Big Duet
episodes.description: Two friends, one song, and very different ideas about how it goes.

episodes.title: Costume Chaos
episodes.description: A wardrobe disaster, fixed with glue, glitter and teamwork.

episodes.title: The Understudy
episodes.description: When the star is sick, someone else has to shine.

episodes.title: Finale Night
episodes.description: Lights up, curtains open. Everyone takes a bow.

novas-dance-party.title: Nova's Dance Party
novas-dance-party.logline: Push back the sofa, it's a dance party!
novas-dance-party.description: Twenty-four minutes of non-stop dancing with the whole crew. Easy moves, big songs, and a very sleepy cool-down with Coco at the end.

zip-zap-skate-park.title: Zip Zap Skate Park
zip-zap-skate-park.logline: Tricks, tumbles and the fastest friend on four wheels.
zip-zap-skate-park.description: Zip wants to land every trick in the book. First, though, Zip has to learn the most important one: getting back up.

episodes.title: The Ollie
episodes.description: The first trick every skater learns, and the hardest.

episodes.title: Helmet Hero
episodes.description: Why the coolest skaters always wear a helmet.

episodes.title: Wobble Board
episodes.description: Balance is a superpower. Zip practises on everything.

episodes.title: The Big Ramp
episodes.description: It looks a lot bigger from the top.

episodes.title: Skate Buddies
episodes.description: Kai tries skating, and Zip learns to go slow.

episodes.title: Zip's First Competition
episodes.description: Winning is fun. Trying your best is better.

ready-set-zip.title: Ready, Set, Zip!
ready-set-zip.description: Jump, stretch, freeze and race with Zip. Every episode is a ten-minute game that gets the whole living room moving.

episodes.title: Jump Like a Frog
episodes.description: Ribbit, bounce, ribbit, bounce!

episodes.title: Stretch Like a Cat
episodes.description: Slow, long, stretchy moves for a sleepy morning.

episodes.title: Freeze Dance
episodes.description: Dance when the music plays. Freeze when it stops!

episodes.title: Balloon Keepy-Uppy
episodes.description: Don't let the balloon touch the floor.

episodes.title: The Floor Is Lava
episodes.description: Cushion to cushion, all the way across the room.

episodes.title: Animal Race
episodes.description: Hop like a bunny, stomp like an elephant, zoom like Zip.

tiva-island-games.title: Tiva Island Games
tiva-island-games.logline: Six friends, ten silly sports, one golden coconut.
tiva-island-games.description: The crew competes in the silliest sports day ever held, where the only rule is to play fair and help your friends up.

episodes.title: Opening Day
episodes.description: The torch is lit and the golden coconut is waiting.

episodes.title: Sack Race Showdown
episodes.description: Hop, hop, hop, flop.

episodes.title: Sandcastle Sprint
episodes.description: Build the tallest castle before the tide comes in.

episodes.title: The Wobbly Relay
episodes.description: Carry an egg on a spoon across a very bouncy bridge.

episodes.title: Tug of Friendship
episodes.description: The rope is long. The argument is longer.

episodes.title: The Golden Coconut
episodes.description: Who wins? Everyone, sort of.

cocos-sleepy-stories.title: Coco's Sleepy Stories
cocos-sleepy-stories.logline: Gentle stories that end with a yawn.
cocos-sleepy-stories.description: Soft voices, slow pictures and quiet stories to help little ones wind down at the end of the day.

episodes.title: The Moon Who Couldn't Sleep
episodes.description: Even the moon needs someone to say goodnight.

episodes.title: The Blanket Fort
episodes.description: The coziest castle in the whole world.

episodes.title: The Quiet Shell
episodes.description: Listen closely. Can you hear the sea?

episodes.title: Counting Sheep at the Beach
episodes.description: One sheep, two sheep, one sheep in sunglasses.

episodes.title: Stars on the Ceiling
episodes.description: Bloop can't sleep, so Coco makes a sky.

episodes.title: Goodnight, Everyone
episodes.description: Goodnight to every friend on Tiva Island.

breathe-with-coco.title: Breathe with Coco
breathe-with-coco.description: Short, simple breathing games for big feelings, before school, after a tumble or at bedtime.

episodes.title: Balloon Breaths
episodes.description: Fill your tummy like a balloon, then let it float away.

episodes.title: Ocean Breathing
episodes.description: Breathe in with the wave, breathe out with the tide.

episodes.title: Squeeze and Relax
episodes.description: Squeeze your hands tight, tight, tight... and let go.

episodes.title: My Happy Place
episodes.description: Close your eyes and imagine somewhere lovely.

episodes.title: Slow Like a Snail
episodes.description: The slowest breath in the world.

moonlight-beach.title: Moonlight Beach
moonlight-beach.logline: Soft lullabies from the quietest beach on the island.
moonlight-beach.description: When the sun goes down, the beach glows. Coco, Kai and Nova sing the island to sleep.

episodes.title: Lullaby for the Tide
episodes.description: The sea sings its own song, if you listen.

episodes.title: The Glowing Sand
episodes.description: Tiny lights sparkle at the water's edge.

episodes.title: Night Birds
episodes.description: Who is singing in the dark?

episodes.title: The Sleepy Lighthouse
episodes.description: The lighthouse keeps watch so everyone else can rest.

trail.title: Welcome to Tiva Island
trail.blurb: Meet the crew and say hello to the island.

trail.title: Kai's Beach
trail.blurb: Waves, turtles and one very brave surfer.

trail.title: Cog's Workshop
trail.blurb: Count, build and ask big questions.

trail.title: Nova's Stage
trail.blurb: Sing it loud and dance it out.

trail.title: Coco's Moonlight Beach
trail.blurb: Slow down, breathe and wind down.

trail.title: The Splash Park Premiere
trail.blurb: The whole crew's big summer movie. You made it!
